description: This Java class 'LabelManagerFactory' manages label files and labels within the Apache OFBiz framework, including loading component names, label files, and finding matching labels based on various criteria.

classes.name: LabelManagerFactory
classes.description: Final class responsible for managing label files and label information within the OFBiz framework, including loading components, label files, and searching for labels.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of LabelManagerFactory, loading component names and label files if necessary.

methods.name: loadComponentNames
methods.description: Loads all component names into the static set componentNamesFound.

methods.name: loadLabelFiles
methods.description: Loads label files from component classpath info locations into the static map filesFound.

methods.name: findMatchingLabels
methods.description: Searches for labels matching specified component, file, key, and locale criteria, optionally filtering out unused labels.

methods.name: getLabelFile
methods.description: Retrieves a LabelFile object by filename.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns the map of label keys to LabelInfo objects.

methods.name: getLocalesFound
methods.description: Returns the set of locales found during label parsing.

methods.name: getFilesFound
methods.description: Returns the collection of all LabelFile objects found.

methods.name: getComponentNamesFound
methods.description: Returns the set of component names discovered.

methods.name: getLabelsList
methods.description: Returns the set of label keys.

methods.name: getDuplicatedLocalesLabels
methods.description: Returns the count of duplicated locale labels.

methods.name: getDuplicatedLocalesLabelsList
methods.description: Returns the list of duplicated locale labels.

methods.name: updateLabelValue
methods.description: Updates or adds label values for multiple locales within a LabelInfo object.
